description: This PHP class defines an ErrorResponse object used in JSON API responses to encapsulate error details, status, title, detail, and exception information, with support for debug mode serialization.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: A class representing an error response for JSON APIs, supporting error details and exception serialization, with optional debug info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ErrorResponse with optional debugExceptions flag, defaulting to ApiConfig setting.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code for the error.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code for the error.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the error.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the error.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed message about the error.

methods.name: setDetail
methods.description: Sets the detailed message about the error.

methods.name: setException
methods.description: Sets an Exception object to be included in error details.

methods.name: getExceptionArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the exception if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the ErrorResponse object to JSON, including exception details if in debug mode.
